name: BusinessLeague Marketing
author: businessleague

sections.faq:
Where do I find my BusinessLeague tracking codes?

You can find your tracking codes in the PDF documentation available in your BusinessLeague account. You’ll need the:
– campaign_unique identifier
– confirm code
– bigbear_unique code

How do variable commissions work?

When enabled, you can set different commission percentages for different product categories. You’ll set a default commission rate, then override it for specific categories. Make sure that you have also registered your program as working with variable commission in your BusinessLeague account and that the default commission set with this plugin is the same as the one registerd in BusinessLeague.
sections.description:
Easily add BusinessLeague tracking to your WooCommerce store and start growing through affiliate-driven sales.

What are the product’s benefits?

BusinessLeague Marketing for WooCommerce allows you to easily implement affiliate tracking with your WooCommerce store. The plugin provides:

  • Quick Setup – Install tracking codes with just a few clicks, no coding needed.
  • Accurate Attribution – Ensures every affiliate sale is correctly tracked and rewarded.
  • Join BusinessLeague – Instantly qualify your store for gamified affiliate competitions.
  • Sales-Only Costs – Pay only for confirmed sales, no upfront ad spend.
  • Real-Time Insights – Get instant reporting on affiliate performance and conversions.
  • Scalable Growth – Unlock access to top digital marketers without agency overhead.
  • Compliance Guaranteed – Fully aligned with BusinessLeagues’ platform standards and data model.

Why was this plugin built?

Many eShops using WooCommerce want to participate in the BusinessLeague, but lack technical support to implement the tracking codes properly. This plugin was built to solve that by simplifying the setup process, enabling more shops to enter the affiliate ecosystem with minimal friction. We’ve seen repeated feature requests from shops during onboarding, and growing demand on social channels and partner webinars.

How does this compare to other similar products?

This is the only official BusinessLeague plug-in. Our plugin offers:
– Official support from BusinessLeague
– Seamless tracking validation
– Access to a real-time competitive marketing environment
– Automated code implementation (vs. manual snippet editing in other plugins)

Installation and usage

  1. Install the plugin via WordPress Dashboard → Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → BusinessLeague Marketing.
  4. Paste your 2Performant Tracking IDs and Save.
  5. Verify integration using the “Test Tracking” feature directly from your BusinessLeague dashboard.
  6. Start tracking conversions in BusinessLeague.

Minimum Requirements

  • PHP 7.2.5 or greater
  • WordPress 5.0 or greater
  • WooCommerce 3.0 or greater
